vocabulary.meaning_en: a pronoun that does the action: I, you, he, she, it, we, they
the person you speak to: you (singular and plural)
the person or thing you speak about: he, she, it, they
a raised box you stand on to speak or to get a medal
vocabulary.example: The three winners stood on the podium.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a round metal prize for winning
the people who watch or listen
send your words to a particular person
vocabulary.example: I direct my speech to you.
You are the type of person who makes friends easily.

fine_lines.title: you (singular) vs you (plural)
fine_lines.explanation_ar: you في الإنجليزية للمفرد والجمع معًا، سواء كلّمت شخصًا واحدًا أو جماعة.
fine_lines.explanation_en: English uses "you" for one person and for many people.

examples.sentence: Ali, you are a good student.
Class, you are all good students.

fine_lines.title: he / she vs it
fine_lines.explanation_ar: he للذكر و she للأنثى، و it للأشياء والحيوانات غير المعروفة والطقس. كلها ضمائر غائب مفردة.
fine_lines.explanation_en: "He" is for a male, "she" for a female, "it" for things, unknown animals and the weather. All are third person singular.

expressions.phrase: It is a very nice sunny day today.
expressions.meaning_ar: إنه يوم مشمس جميل جدًا اليوم.
expressions.example: It is a very nice sunny day today. Let's go to the park.

expressions.meaning_en: You are the best, in my opinion (a joke in the video).
expressions.example: Great job! You're first in my books.

grammar.title: First person: the speaker
grammar.explanation_ar: عندما أتكلم عن نفسي أستعمل I (مفرد)، وعندما أتكلم عن نفسي مع جماعتي أستعمل we (جمع).
grammar.explanation_en: When I speak about myself, I use "I" (singular). When I speak about my group and me, I use "we" (plural).
examples: I am talking to them later.

grammar.title: Second person: the listener
grammar.explanation_ar: عندما أوجّه كلامي مباشرة لشخص أو لجماعة أستعمل you للمفرد والجمع.
grammar.explanation_en: When I speak directly to a person or a group, I use "you" for both singular and plural.
examples: You are the type of person who makes friends easily.

grammar.title: Third person: who or what we talk about
grammar.explanation_ar: عندما أتكلم عن شخص أو شيء غير مشارك في الحديث أستعمل he / she / it للمفرد، و they للجمع.
grammar.explanation_en: When I speak about a person or thing not in the conversation, I use he / she / it (singular) and they (plural).
examples: I saw them yesterday and they said they were going home.

grammar.title: Clues for choosing the pronoun
grammar.explanation_ar: انظر إلى الفعل والكلمات حولك: am يأتي مع I فقط. them و their تدل على they. the type of person تدل على مفرد. sunny day شيء فنستعمل it.
grammar.explanation_en: Look at the verb and nearby words: "am" goes only with I. "Them" and "their" point to "they". "The type of person" is singular. A sunny day is a thing, so use "it".

questions.question: "I saw them yesterday and ___ said they were going home."
questions.explanation_en: We are talking about a group: they.

questions.question: "___ are the type of person who makes friends easily." (I'm speaking to you)
"___ is a very nice sunny day today."
questions.explanation_en: A sunny day is a thing: it.

questions.question: Which is the first person plural?
Which pronoun is used for both singular and plural?
What is a "podium"?
choices: a raised box to stand on
questions.explanation_en: A podium is a raised box to stand on.
